headline: A 2007 executive order directs federal action to protect striped bass and red drum fish populations.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President George W. Bush, deals with protecting two kinds of fish, striped bass and red drum. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires of federal agencies cannot be confirmed here. Based on the title, it likely sets federal policy on how these fish are caught or managed.

who_it_affects.how: People who catch striped bass or red drum may face federal rules or policies about these fish.
Agencies that manage ocean fish are likely directed to take steps to protect these two species.
